title: So helpful love it 😊
body:
Roubit is a really helpful journaling app for your device unlike other apps that you would use to journal for example when you would write down your thoughts on that journal you would normally logout and 9 out of 10 times. You wouldn’t feel better but that’s not Roubit.
Roubit helps you get through your complications for example when you write your thoughts down on the journal Roubit will give you a notification saying,” your letter of support has arrived” and when you click on timeline and you click on receive letter it gives you a letter of support when I found this out I clicked on timeline and I read the letter and that day. I was having a lot of anxiety and stress and when I read the letter I felt those feelings slowly drift away so I really really recommend this app for people who struggle with anxiety or stress or even if you’re having a really good day and just wanna share it with somebody. Roubit is the app for that.

title: Very pretty and aesthetic app but loads a lot
